answer: Proof of Useful Work serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to expend computational energy akin to moving a basalt monolith. By linking identity to verifiable labor rather than arbitrary tokens, it creates a gale of resource demand that forces attackers to pay significant hardware costs for each new persona. Much like a sonnet demands precise linguistic form, this protocol demands proof of utility, ensuring that maintaining an army of fake identities becomes economically ruinous.
